headline: Klabin Warns El Niño Rains Will Pressure Operations Through Early 2027
summary: Brazilian pulp and paper producer Klabin stated that heavy rainfall driven by El Niño in its pine timber plantations in Paraná will continue to pressure operations through the first quarter of 2027.
why: Weather anomalies directly impact forestry and agricultural supply chains, affecting raw material availability and operating costs for industrial producers.

impacts.name: Klabin SA
impacts.why: Operational disruptions from severe weather can elevate harvesting costs and constrain output volumes.
